Nurture Massage Therapy provides support and empowerment wherever you are on your motherhood journey, by offering skilled therapeutic massage, education and community. 

We nurture your physical and emotional wellbeing, and have a passion for helping to support your family!

Disclaimer: All of the material provided by Nurture Massage Therapy channel is for educational purposes only. This information does not replace medical advice nor present treatment programs. Please a consult medical professional if you are presently under a physicians care, if you are taking medication, or need additional medical care. Nurture Massage Therapy and its associates do not warrant, assume legal liability, or responsibility for the completeness, accuracy, or usefulness of the information.

This is an unmonitored channel, and often will not see new comments. If you have questions send us an email ☺️
